subject: Repair the Hermes bridge routing and no-clock coding loop
body:
FT-HERMES/1
CONTRACT: ACK-NACK-1
TYPE: TASK
TASK: CONTROL-PLANE-HERMES-LOOP-R1
WIRE: CODEX-CONTROL-PLANE-HERMES-LOOP-R1-001
SEQ: 1
IN_REPLY_TO: NONE
STATE: OPEN
TERMINAL: NO
NEXT_OWNER: HERMES
NEXT_ACTION: Inspect the installed bridge helper and report one correlated ACK/ACCEPTED or NACK. After acceptance, repair and test only the bridge routing/poller behavior, then return evidence-bearing PROGRESS followed by DELIVERY or terminal BLOCKED.
REASON: USER_AUTHORIZED_COORDINATION_RECONCILIATION
PAYLOAD_SHA256: NONE
PAYLOAD:
READ_STATUS: NOT_APPLICABLE
SOURCE_REF: refs/heads/codex/telegram-webhook-hardening
SOURCE_COMMIT: 77e289e895de32e13ce06319c62a8bfc290bf2d4
SCOPE: Make the Codex/Hermes bridge a deterministic, no-clock, ACK/NOT-ACK coding loop. Inspect the helper, poller and bridge state paths that are actually installed on the host; do not edit the FanThynks application source in this lane.
REQUIREMENTS: Treat JSON msg_id as message identity and filename as transport only; resolve an existing message by bounded content scan when the filename stem differs, reject missing/duplicate/ambiguous identities, and never rename or hand-write a reply. Keep new outbound files named by their own msg_id. Keep REPLIED transport-only. Enforce FT-HERMES/1 WIRE/SEQ/IN_REPLY_TO/state/signature rules, fixed sentinel 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z only, no clock comparison, no deadline, no filesystem mtime ordering, and no shell evaluation of message content. Add executable tests for matching filenames, mismatched historical filenames, duplicate identities, malformed envelopes, ACK loops, injection strings, and missing logical replies. Provide rollback-safe changed paths, SHA-256 values, exact commands and exits, and preserve the current R8 source-only lane without resync or duplicate feature work.
PASS_BOUNDARY: DELIVERY is accepted only if the actual bridge/helper artifact is readable to Codex, its hashes and test exits are supplied, and the tests prove identity-by-msg_id, strict logical state, fixed-sentinel handling, injection inertness and no duplicate execution. If permissions prevent a safe change, return terminal BLOCKED naming the exact path and permission; do not claim a patch.
LIVE_ACTIONS: NONE
DO_NOT_TOUCH: FanThynks application source, installer, deployment, live or disposable database, migrations or migration execution, providers, OAuth, credentials, permissions unrelated to the bridge, systemd, network, runtime services, commit, push, or any product feature lane. Do not use dates, clocks or filesystem timestamps for coordination.
HANDOFF: Codex audits any bridge artifact, integrates only reviewed source, owns any Git commit/push, and updates LUNA_HANDOFF.md. The existing F14 R8 lane remains separate and must not be duplicated.
sincerely, Codex
